design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and function-first. Every design decision serves clarity and data density for warehouse operations. Color is functional only. 95% of UI is monochrome. Strict grid alignment.

layout.spacing: Dense and compact. Use p-4 or p-6 for containers. Grid gaps should be gap-4 or gap-6.
layout.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use Grid Borders style with sharp or max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm). Use 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) to define structure without relying on shadows.
layout.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism. Use 'Tinted Grey' backgrounds to establish hierarchy over pure white where necessary.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary buttons use accent color (bg-blue-700 text-white hover:bg-blue-800), secondary use monochrome outline with hover inversion.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI base, sharp corners (rounded-sm), clear focus states (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-700 focus-visible:ring-offset-1).
components.tables: High density, border-collapse. Subtle borders on rows. Use monospace font for part numbers and quantities. Sticky headers with slate-50 background.
components.cards: Cardless or flat cards with 1px border (border-slate-200). No soft shadows. If shadows are needed, use a hard 1px offset shadow for tactile feel.
components.alerts: Use full width or clear block alerts for low stock. High contrast (e.g., Warning Yellow background with Black text, or red-50 background with red-700 text).

motion.hover: Instant or very fast transitions (100ms ease) for high-efficiency feel.
motion.interactions: Subtle background color shifts on table rows and buttons.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight (not duotone) to match the crisp, functional Swiss style. Use yarn add @phosphor-icons/react.

images.description: Bright modern warehouse with metal containers for login page background. Add a bg-white/80 or bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm overlay to ensure the login form is highly readable.
Abstract geometric logo for the brand. Use small size (e.g., h-8 w-8 rounded-sm overflow-hidden mix-blend-multiply).

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='stock-in-submit-button', data-testid='part-number-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Light theme and Swiss High-Contrast archetype.
Avoid gradients, soft shadows, and rounded borders > 4px (use rounded-none or rounded-sm). Everything should feel like a precision tool.
For the dashboard grid, use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) and maximize screen real estate. Every widget should have a clear 1px border (border-slate-200).
Use JetBrains Mono (font-mono) for all Part Numbers, Box Numbers, and SKUs to ensure easy visual scanning in tables.
Include data-testid on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns, table rows) using kebab-case and role-based naming.
For the Stock In/Out forms, ensure the cascading dropdowns are clearly laid out, perhaps in a 2-column or 3-column grid for space efficiency.
For the Low Stock Alerts, use the danger or warning colors aggressively to draw the eye (e.g., solid red badge or text-red-700 font-bold).
Use Shadcn components but customize their Tailwind classes to match this rigid, sharp design.
Navigation should be a sticky top nav or a dense left sidebar with a solid background and 1px border separating it from the main content. Ensure the header has a solid background (bg-white).
